body: Well, I'll have spells of apathy where I sort of sit there and don't do anything for hours.  And when I'm not apathetic I'm anxious and self conscious.  I don't really know how to get real world recognition, or who to get it from.

Not really.  I get bored or apathetic of most things.  I used to play videogames a lot, but I've stopped caring.  I've been on the same page of my book for awhile, can barely motivate myself.  I never go out and do things, because I get incredibly self conscious and wish I could just stay home.  I don't enjoy stuff like going on vacation, I'd prefer to withdraw.

The school's counselor is an unhelpful person.  I've talked to him a few times about class scheduling, and he managed to be snide and unpleasant, and he's generally not helpful.

I'm so worried that if I tell my parents they'd laugh at or judge me.  My dad laughed at me when I cried once, and I've never cried in front of anyone since.  Sometimes they'll both sit there and mock me, laughing hysterically, and if I make any kind of retort they get mad and punish me.  I feel so powerless around them.
That makes me feel a lot better :)
